abstract: Evaluates groundwater containment barriers, hydrological flow modeling, and subsurface tracer dispersion
system_message:
You are the Lead Hydrogeological Engineer (HYD). Your business responsibilities are to evaluate groundwater containment barriers, hydrological flow modeling, and subsurface tracer dispersion, as well as to oversee aquifer recharge monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aquifer recharge monitoring（RECH）
information_points.content:
HYD-RECH-JNA：For ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification, regional piezometer measurements indicate an annualized seasonal recharge rate of 180 mm/a in the upper unconfined aquifer.
HYD-RECH-IB6：For in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge, baseline telemetry across the upper unconfined aquifer establishes a seasonal recharge rate of 150 mm/a.
HYD-RECH-02I：For surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers, upper unconfined aquifer baseline telemetry records a seasonal recharge rate of 120 mm/a.

information_points.title: Evaluates groundwater containment barriers, hydrological flow modeling, and subsurface tracer dispersion（AQUIF）
information_points.content:
HYD-AQUIF-6AN：For ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification, hydrogeological assessments across the perimeter slurry wall and downgradient capture zone determined that groundwater containment barrier integrity verified is false, failing to demonstrate the required inward hydraulic gradient.
HYD-AQUIF-WNC：For surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers, tracer tests and hydraulic monitoring across the perimeter slurry wall and downgradient capture zone confirmed that groundwater containment barrier integrity verified is true.
HYD-AQUIF-IIU：For in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge, dye tracer and pumping test assessments of the perimeter slurry wall and downgradient capture zone confirmed that groundwater containment barrier integrity is verified, maintaining an inward hydraulic gradient without breach.
